More On How It Works

See your event through the eyes of your guests and re-live it all over again.

with GUESTPIX™ you'll enjoy...

social engagement​

Get double the photos and 5x the videos with social features included with every package.

live slideshow

Activate the slideshow and watch as photos are automatically added each rotation. Using a projector is a great way to showcase your celebration for all to enjoy!

written & video guestbook

Receive written and video guest book photo messages from guests in a CSV file. It’s the perfect accompaniment to your photo collection, no matter what type of event you’re hosting.

digital invitations & RSVPs

Easily set up a digital invitation in seconds! Share your digital invitation link with guests & track RSVPs. No printing, no hassle.

QR code & private link

Your custom QR code is your ticket to receiving content from your guests. Add it to invitations, table cards, signage, and more! Or send your private link digitally.

180+ Canva templates

Receive links to 180+ Canva templates to edit and print locally with your QR code. Includes welcome sign, table cards, mini take-home cards and I Spy game.

super albums

Our album technology is the best in market and provides privacy and access controls that elevate albums to events in their own right

zip download

Ready to download your event gallery? Everything is zipped and ready to download within 12 months of your event. It’s the perfect way to keep, share or print in the future.

FREE Bonus: Editable Party QR Code Canva Templates Included

With every GUESTPIX™ purchase, you’ll receive access to our gorgeous range of 180+ print templates! Add your GUESTPIX™ QR code to mini take-home cards, table cards or your welcome sign as a reminder for guests to share their photos and videos.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many photos can guests upload?

All paid GUESTPIX™ party packages include unlimited photo uploads. Our free trial package allows up to 50 photos, so you can test the platform before your event.

Is there a digital guestbook for messages?

Yes. Your gallery includes a digital guestbook where guests can leave written messages or video testimonials alongside their photos and videos. You can download all these memories in ZIP file.

How do the live photos and videos appear?

The gallery is “live.” As soon as a guest scans your QR code and hits upload, their photos and videos appear in the gallery for everyone to see. There is no waiting for the host to “approve” or “sync” the content.

Can I use this for a Milestone Birthday or Baby Shower?

Definitely. While this is our general party page, GUESTPIX™ is the #1 choice for 21st, 30th, 50th birthdays, baby showers, graduations, and reunions. You can even choose a design theme that matches your specific celebration.

What happens to the photos after the party?

Paid galleries remains active for 12 months for downloads. As the host, you can download everything in full resolution to print, share on social media, or keep as a digital keepsake of your celebration.

Do guests need to create an account?

No. We are an app-free and registration-free platform. Guests only need to scan your QR code or tap your private link to start sharing. This ensures maximum participation from all your guests.

Is there customer support?

Yes, we have customer care support 7 days a week with extended hours to cover multiple time zones. You can visit our Help Center for more information or to contact us.

More About GUESTPIX™ Party

Every great celebration deserves lasting memories, and finding creative ways to capture them has never been easier. Whether you’re planning a birthday, baby shower, or graduation, incorporating a digital element into your event makes sharing and preserving special moments effortless. While traditional guestbooks are still used, many hosts are now looking for alternatives to guestbook websites that offer a more interactive and visual way to remember the occasion.

For expectant parents, a baby shower guest book is a wonderful keepsake, but instead of just collecting signatures, why not encourage guests to share photos and heartfelt messages digitally? A QR code linked to a shared album allows guests to upload pictures and leave notes, creating a modern and interactive experience. Similarly, a party photo booth is a fantastic way to capture fun, candid moments. With the right backdrop and props, guests can snap pictures and instantly share them, making the event even more memorable.

If you’re looking for an easy way to design invites, GUESTPIX™ offers access to 50+ editable Canva templates with every purchase. Using a party invitation template can save time while keeping your event stylish and organized. Whether you need a graduation party invitation template for a milestone celebration or a birthday invite that matches your party theme, the GUESTPIX™ suite of customizable templates makes it simple to create something unique and personal.

From digital guestbooks to QR-powered photo sharing and modern invitations, today’s party planning options make it easier than ever to bring people together and preserve memories. No matter the occasion, incorporating fun and interactive elements ensures your celebration is one to remember!
